metadata.name: fair_open
metadata.description: The Fair Open program: deposits, the open and the pot

instructions.name: claim
docs: A depositor takes their seat's coins and refund themselves, if no push has (spec 2.1 step 12), into any account of
the coin they own; the coin account's prepaid rent comes back with the refund. The creator's seat is the Creator
lock's alone.

instructions.name: close_launch
docs: Closes a launch once it is done, giving the creator back the rent of the launch and its vault, with what is left of
the rent they prepaid (spec 2.1 step 7): a failed launch once every seat has been returned, an opened one once its
Tax Share is collected and every seat, the creator's with the Creator lock, has closed. Anyone may send it; it pays
only the creator.

instructions.name: collect_tax_share
docs: The Tax Share's collection (spec 2.1 step 14, 4): anyone may send it once the coin's Tax window has ended, and our
keeper does at 60 s. It opens the launch's pot again, has the fee program's window claim pay the window's fees,
less the pot's own fee, into it, and unwraps them into the vault, all in this instruction. The Tax Share is those
fees and the lamport dust the open's rounding gathered, paid to every seat but the creator's in proportion to its
fill, which is in proportion to the SOL it spent. With no seat but the creator's, nobody may take it, so it goes
to Heat's treasury, as an Instant launch's window fees do.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Schedules a Fair Open (spec 2.1 steps 4 to 7): its window, its optional minimum raise and the hash its coin's
identity is sealed behind, on Heat's Fair Open config and with the durable nonce its open will be signed on. The
Creator wallet signs and prepays the rent of the launch and its vault; our keeper co-signs, so every launch is
one Heat scheduled, as every Heat coin is one our launch key co-signed (spec 2.4).

accounts.name: creator
docs: The Creator wallet, which pays the rent.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: handler.

accounts.name: nonce
docs: the handler.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: A deposit during the window (spec 2.1 step 9), with our admission server's signature over who may make it, as an
Ed25519 precompile instruction right before this one. The first wallet of a person takes their seat and prepays
its rent and their coin account's; a second wallet of the same person is refused, so one person holds one seat
and one cap. The same wallet may add to its deposit, under the cap of its latest admission. Nothing is ever
revoked inside a window.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the `ProgramConfig`. Only the program's upgrade authority may, so whoever controls upgrades also
controls the admission signer and the keeper (spec 5.3): a plain offline key on devnet, Squads behind a 7-day
timelock on mainnet.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData, at the address the upgradeable loader derives from the program id.

instructions.name: lock_creator
docs: The Creator lock (spec 2.1 step 13, ADR 0004): anyone may send it once the launch has opened, and our keeper does at
once. The creator's seat's coins go from the pot into a Jupiter Lock escrow, nothing released for 7 days after the
open and all of it by day 30, the Creator wallet its recipient and the only one who can change that, and nobody,
Heat included, able to cancel it. The pot approves the creator locker for exactly those coins and the locker sends
them, so they can leave the pot for the escrow alone. The escrow's rent comes out of the creator's prepaid rent,
or, for a launch scheduled before the prepayment covered it, out of the seat's refund; the rest of the seat's
refund, its prepaid coin-account rent and the seat's own rent go back to the Creator wallet, and the seat closes:
it gets no Tax Share.

accounts.name: seat
docs: The Creator wallet's seat, which closes into the Creator wallet.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The Creator wallet: the escrow's recipient, and paid the seat's refund and rents.

instructions.name: mark_failed
docs: Marks a launch that cannot open as failed, so no coin is ever created and every deposit comes back (spec 2.1
step 15). Anyone may send it once the window has closed: at once when the pot would spend less than the lowest
rung or the minimum raise, and from 15 minutes after the scheduled open whatever the pot holds.

instructions.name: open
docs: The open (spec 2.1 step 10): the first of this program's two instructions in the coin's creation transaction, the
rung of the creator's ladder that our keeper sends at the scheduled time. It refuses before the scheduled time and
from 15 minutes after it, a pot that cannot open, any rung but the largest at or below what the pot should spend,
and any transaction but the creation transaction (`creation`). It then wraps exactly the rung into the pot's
wrapped-SOL account and lets our keeper spend exactly that, as the pot's delegate, in DBC's swap.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Our keeper, which sends the open, fronts its accounts' rent and spends exactly the buy as the pot's delegate.

instructions.name: push
docs: Delivers seats their coins and refund once the launch has opened (spec 2.1 step 12): anyone may send it, and our
keeper does at once. Each seat comes as three remaining accounts: the seat, its wallet, and the wallet's own
account of the coin, which the push makes from the rent the seat prepaid, or, if it exists already, returns that
rent with the refund. A seat already delivered is passed over, and so is the creator's, whose coins leave the pot
only into the Creator lock (spec 2.1 step 13), so a push sent twice delivers nothing twice.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever sends the push: the Associated Token Account program's payer, though the seats' prepaid rent funds every
account it makes.

instructions.name: push_tax_share
docs: Pays seats their Tax Share and closes them, returning each seat's rent (spec 2.1 step 14): anyone may send it once
the Tax Share is collected, and our keeper does at once. Each seat comes as two remaining accounts, the seat and
its wallet; a seat whose coins and refund have not been delivered yet waits, since closing it would lose them, and
the creator's seat, which gets no Tax Share, closes with the Creator lock.

instructions.name: settle
docs: The last instruction of the creation transaction (spec 2.1 step 10). DBC's swap has spent exactly the rung, so the
pot's wrapped-SOL account closes back into the vault; the coins it bought are recorded; the pool's partner fee,
at this instant exactly the pot's own fee, is recorded with the coin's registration in the fee program; and our
keeper is paid back what the open's accounts cost it, out of the rent the creator prepaid.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Our keeper, which is paid back the rent of the open's accounts.

instructions.name: update_program_config
docs: Replaces the settings, again only by the upgrade authority: how a leaked admission or keeper key is rotated.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData, at the address the upgradeable loader derives from the program id.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Takes back part or all of a deposit while the window is open (spec 2.1 step 9). Taking back everything closes
the seat and returns both rents.

instructions.name: withdraw_failed
docs: Returns a failed launch's deposit and both rents to its depositor's wallet (spec 2.1 step 15). The depositor can
send it alone, with no Heat server running; anyone else may send it too, since it pays only that wallet.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The seat's wallet, which everything goes back to.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

errors.msg: A setting is the default address

errors.name: NotTheKeeper
errors.msg: The keeper did not sign

errors.msg: A Fair Open runs on Heat's Fair Open config

errors.name: NotADbcConfig
errors.msg: The config is not a DBC config

errors.name: QuoteNotSupported
errors.msg: A Fair Open takes SOL only, until another quote's deposits are built

errors.name: MinRaiseAboveCap
errors.msg: The minimum raise is more than the pot can spend

errors.name: WindowOver

errors.name: TooFarAhead
errors.msg: A window starts at most 7 days ahead

errors.name: OffStep

errors.name: SeatHeldByAnotherWallet

errors.name: OverCap

errors.name: OverDeposit
errors.msg: That is more than the seat holds

errors.name: TooManySeats

errors.name: NotFailed

errors.name: CannotOpen

types.name: Admission
docs: Who our admission server admitted to a launch, as the deposit carries it.

fields.name: person
docs: The person's pseudonym in this launch: a keyed hash of their cluster id, salted per launch, so the chain never
links one person's wallets across launches (spec 5.3).

fields.name: cap
docs: The most the person may have in the launch, in the quote's raw units: at most their tier's cap.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: When the admission lapses, a Unix timestamp.

types.name: CoinDustBurnt
docs: Every seat delivered: the coins the rounding left in the pot burnt (spec 12).

types.name: CreatorLocked
docs: The Creator lock (spec 2.1 step 13): the creator's coins in a Jupiter Lock escrow, and their seat closed.

fields.name: person
docs: The creator's pseudonym in this launch, their seat's.

fields.name: escrow
docs: The escrow, none when the creator's fill bought no coins.

fields.name: opened_at
docs: When trading opened, when the release starts and when all of it is free, Unix timestamps.

fields.name: rent
docs: What the escrow and its coin account cost, and the part of it that came out of the seat's refund.

fields.name: paid
docs: The seat's refund and prepaid coin-account rent, less that part, paid to the Creator wallet; and the seat's own
rent, which it gets back as the seat closes.

types.name: Deposited
docs: A deposit: `amount` added, `deposit` what the seat now holds; `pot` and `seats` the launch's after it.

fields.name: new_seat
docs: Whether this deposit took the seat, and so prepaid its rent and the coin account's.

types.name: FailedDepositReturned
docs: A failed launch's seat returned: its deposit, the coin account's rent and the seat's own rent, to its wallet.

fields.name: seats
docs: Seats still holding a deposit.

types.name: Launch
docs: One per Fair Open, at the PDA of its durable nonce account: its schedule and terms, and how many seats ask each
deposit, from which the allocation is found with no list of seats (spec 2.1 step 11).

fields.name: creator
docs: The Creator wallet: signs the launch, pays its rent and gets it back, and its seat is the creator's seat.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The durable nonce the open is signed on, which only our keeper may advance.

fields.name: deposits_open_at
docs: When the window opens and when it closes, which is the scheduled open, Unix timestamps.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: In the quote's raw units: the least the pot must spend, the most it may (20% of the Graduation Target), and the
ladder's lowest rung, below which it cannot open.

fields.name: step
docs: The deposit step, in the quote's raw units.

fields.name: failure
docs: Why the launch failed and when, by the chain's clock.

fields.name: seats
docs: Seats holding a deposit.

fields.name: unverified_deposits
docs: What each tier's seats have deposited, in the quote's raw units.

fields.name: coin_rent
docs: The coin-account rent the seats prepaid, held in the vault until the push or a refund.

fields.name: counts
docs: How many Scored and Verified seats ask each deposit: `counts[k]` ask `(k + 1)` steps, up to the Verified cap.

fields.name: unverified_counts
docs: How many Unverified seats ask each deposit, up to the Unverified cap.

fields.name: open_rent
docs: What the open's accounts cost, prepaid by the creator at scheduling and held in the vault; after the open, what
is left of it once our keeper has been paid back, which comes back to the creator.

fields.name: mint
docs: The coin, from the open on.

fields.name: keeper_lamports
docs: Our keeper's balance as the open began, inside the creation transaction alone.

fields.name: spend
docs: At the open, in the quote's raw units: what the fills added up to, and each level (spec 2.1 step 11).

fields.name: spent
docs: The rung: what the pot spent, in the quote's raw units; and the coins it bought.

fields.name: refunded
docs: The refunds pushes and claims have paid, and from the Tax Share's collection on, the lamport dust the rounding
gathered too, which the Tax Share holds since; and how many seats still open have had their coins and refund.

fields.name: creator_deposit
docs: What the Creator wallet's own seat asks and its tier, while it holds one (spec 2.1 step 13): its coins go only into
the Creator lock, and it gets no Tax Share.

fields.name: tax_collected
docs: Whether the window's fees are collected into the Tax Share (spec 2.1 step 14), and the Tax Share, in the quote's
raw units: those fees and the lamport dust of the open's rounding, what the seats are paid from.

fields.name: tax_fills_paid
docs: The fills of the seats paid their Tax Share so far, from which each next seat's share is found to the lamport.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room kept, so the account keeps its size.

types.name: LaunchClosed
docs: A failed launch closed, its rent and its vault's returned to the creator.

types.name: LaunchCreated
docs: A Fair Open scheduled: its terms, as the launch account holds them.

fields.name: spend
docs: What the pot would have spent, and what it held.

types.name: LaunchOpened
docs: A Fair Open opened (spec 2.1 step 10): its coin and pool created and the pot's buy their first swap. Amounts are in the
quote's raw units, coins in the coin's.

fields.name: spend
docs: What the fills added up to, and the rung, what the pot spent.

fields.name: pot_fee
docs: The pot's own fee, recorded with the fee program for its 50/50 split.

fields.name: rent_paid_back
docs: What the open's accounts cost our keeper, paid back from the creator's prepaid rent.

types.name: LaunchParams
docs: What the creator chooses when scheduling (spec 2.1 steps 4 and 5).

fields.name: deposits_open_at
docs: When the window opens, a Unix timestamp; it closes 10 minutes later, at the scheduled open.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: The least the pot must spend for the coin to be created, in the quote's raw units; 0 for none.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: The SHA-256 the coin's name, ticker and metadata URI are sealed behind: of DBC's `initialize_virtual_pool`
parameters as they are serialized, which the open checks against the coin it creates (spec 2.1 step 5).

types.name: ProgramSettings
docs: Who the program trusts: the admission signer and the keeper, which program its coins register with, and the config
its launches run on.

fields.name: admission_signer
docs: Signs each deposit's admission (spec 10.3), and holds no funds.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Heat's keeper key: co-signs every launch, holds each launch's durable nonce, and sends the open.

fields.name: fee_program
docs: The fee program, which `settle` registers each Fair Open's coin with.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: Heat's Fair Open DBC config: every launch's coin is created on it.

types.name: Seat
docs: One per launch and person, at the PDA of the launch and the person's pseudonym, held by the one wallet that took it

fields.name: person
docs: The person's pseudonym in this launch.

fields.name: cap
docs: The most the seat may hold, in the quote's raw units, from its latest admission.

fields.name: deposit
docs: What the seat has deposited: what it asks the pot to buy with.

fields.name: coin_rent
docs: The coin account's rent the depositor prepaid, which the push spends or returns.

fields.name: spent
docs: Once delivered (spec 2.1 step 12): what its deposit spent, the coins it bought, and its refund.

fields.name: delivered
docs: Whether a push or its own claim has delivered its coins and refund.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for what the Tax Share will record.

types.name: SeatDelivered
docs: A seat's coins and refund delivered, by a push or its own claim (spec 2.1 step 12).

fields.name: coin_account
docs: Where its coins went.

fields.name: coin_rent
docs: The coin account's prepaid rent paid back with the refund: none when the push made the account with it.

fields.name: pushed
docs: Whether a push delivered it, or the depositor's own claim.

fields.name: delivered
docs: Seats delivered so far.

types.name: TaxShareCollected
docs: The Tax Share collected (spec 2.1 step 14), in the quote's raw units: the window's fees less the pot's own fee, and the
lamport dust of the open's rounding.

fields.name: basis
docs: The fills it is shared by: every seat's but the creator's.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Heat's treasury, when no seat but the creator's could take it and it went there.

types.name: TaxSharePaid
docs: A seat paid its Tax Share and closed, its rent returned to its wallet.

fields.name: seats
docs: Seats left open.

types.name: Tier
docs: A person's Depositor tier (spec 2.1 step 9, 6.3): how strongly they have shown they are one person.

types.name: Vault
docs: Holds a launch's deposits as plain SOL (spec 5.3), at the PDA of its launch.

types.name: Withdrawn
docs: A withdrawal during the window: `deposit` what the seat still holds; the seat closed if nothing.

constants.name: CREATOR_LOCK_CLIFF_SECONDS
docs: The Creator lock (spec 2.1 step 13, 12): nothing released for 7 days after the open, then a straight-line release,
second by second, until all of it is free 30 days after the open.

constants.name: DEPOSIT_STEP
docs: The deposit step (spec 12): deposits, withdrawals and caps move in 0.01 SOL.

constants.name: LATE_OPEN_SECONDS
docs: From 15 minutes after the scheduled open, the open is refused and anyone may mark the launch failed (spec 2.1
step 15).

constants.name: MAX_SCHEDULE_SECONDS
docs: How far ahead a window may start (spec 2.1 step 4): 7 days.

constants.name: POT_CAP_PERCENT
docs: The pot's cap, as a share of the config's Graduation Target (spec 12): 20%.

constants.name: UNVERIFIED_CAP_STEPS
docs: Each Depositor tier's cap per Fair Open, in deposit steps (spec 2.1 step 9): Unverified 0.1 SOL, Scored 0.5 SOL,
Verified 2 SOL. Our admission server signs each person's cap, and a stolen admission key still admits no one above
these.

constants.name: WINDOW_SECONDS
docs: The deposit window (spec 2.1 step 4): a fixed 10 minutes, ending at the scheduled open.
